description: Single-layer ligand classification for REEL-QUEST v13. The 21 Subtype labels are the canonical and only classification. Both record fields (Chemical_Family and Subtype) carry the same Subtype label. v12's two-layer Chemical_Family taxonomy was retired in v13. Each Subtype carries a donor_group attribute on the vocab side (O_donor / N_O_hybrid / N_donor / P_donor) for documentation and figure-coloring only — it is not stored on records.
record_field_note: Both fields hold the same 21-label classification for schema stability across earlier consumer code.

O_donor.description: All-oxygen donor ligands: diglycolyl-bisamides, polyether diamides, monoamides, chelating bisamides, crown ethers, and polyphenols.

N_O_hybrid.description: Mixed N + O donors: N-centered chelators with carboxylate/amide arms; heterocyclic scaffolds (phen, pyridine, bipyridine) with pendant amide arms.

N_donor.description: All-nitrogen multidentate donors without amide or P=O arms (BTP, BTBP, BTPhen, BPyrPhen).

P_donor.description: P-centered donors classified by P-functional group, ignoring the rest of the molecular scaffold. Members previously under Amide_Phosphoryl and Phenanthroline_Phosphoryl (v12) are folded into the matching P-functional subtype.

DGA.description: Tridentate O3 diglycolyl-bisamide (2 amide-O + 1 ether-O) — monomeric (TODGA-type) and pre-organized BisDGA (xylylene- or alkyl-tethered).

Tripodal-DGA.description: Tripodal scaffold with three diglycolamide arms (e.g., TriEtTriDoDGA, TREN-DGA).

Polyether_Diamide.description: Tetradentate O4 polyether-diamide (2 amide-O + 2 ether-O) — extended-glycol analogue of DGA (DOODA = dioxa-octanediamide).

Amide.description: Simple N,N-dialkyl alkanamide; O1 monoamide donor (DHOA-type).

Phthalamic_acid.description: Amide-carboxylate hybrid (phthalamic-acid-type) chelating O2 bidentate via amide-O + COOH-O.

Malonamide.description: 1,3-Bisamide donor with malonyl (C1) bridge; O2 chelating (DMDOHEMA, TOMA).

Crown_ether.description: Macrocyclic polyether O-donor; primarily 18-crown-6 and dibenzo/dicyclohexyl/dipyridino derivatives.

Nitrilotriacetamide.description: N-centered tripod with three amide arms (HONTA-style); N1O3 multidentate.

EDTA.description: Aminopolycarboxylic acid chelators (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid family); HEDTA, CyDTA, etc.

BLPhen.description: Bis-lactam (bi-loop) 1,10-phenanthroline diamide: one phen core with two fused lactam amide loops (BLPhen-type); the preorganized counterpart of DAPhen.

Bipydiamide.description: 6,6'-Bipyridyl-2,2'-dicarboxamide scaffold (BPyDA-type); N2O2. Holds both open-chain (BABPy-type) and preorganized bis-lactam (BLBPy) variants, the way DGA holds monomeric and pre-organized members.

Multident_N_donor.description: All-nitrogen multidentate donor: 2,6-bis(triazinyl)pyridines (BTP, N3), 6,6'-bis(triazinyl)bipyridines (BTBP, N4), bis(pyrazolyl)/bis(triazinyl)phenanthrolines (BPyrPhen/BTPhen, N4). No amide or P=O arms.

Phosphine_oxide.description: P with three P-C bonds; R3P=O. Includes pure phosphine oxides (TBPO-type), CMPO-family amidophosphine-oxides, and phen-P=O phosphine-oxide phenanthrolines.

Phosphonate.description: P with at least one P-C bond and at least one P-O ester/acid bond. Includes neutral phosphonate diesters R-P(=O)(OR)2 (DHDECMP, DHDECEP), phosphonate monoester acids R-P(=O)(OR)OH (HEH[EHP] / PC88A / P507), amidophosphonates, and phen-phosphonates.

Phosphate.description: P with three P-OR bonds (no P-C, no P-OH); (RO)3P=O — trialkyl phosphate (TBP-type).

Phosphoric_acid.description: P with NO P-C bond and at least one P-OH; (RO)2P(=O)OH or (RO)P(=O)(OH)2 — acidic phosphate ester (HDEHP/DHPA-type). Note: phosphonate monoester acids (R-P(=O)(OR)OH) are NOT Phosphoric_acid — they go to Phosphonate.

p_functional_smarts._comment: SMARTS used to assign P-subtypes by P-functional group. Match order matters — check the P-C bond count FIRST (Phosphine_oxide / Phosphonate), then fall through to all-O variants (Phosphate / Phosphoric_acid). The legacy 'check P-OH first' order mis-bucketed phosphonate monoester acids like HEH[EHP].

v12_to_v13_consolidations._comment: Documentation of how v12 subtypes mapped into v13 subtypes.
